entities.summary: Pouye (Bouye) is a language spoken in Sandaun Province, Papua New Guinea, by a thousand people, and growing. It is spoken in the seven villages of Bulawa, Kiliauto, Komtin, Maurom, Wokien, Wulme, and Yukilau, which are mostly located within East Wapei Rural LLG.
